metadata.description: Claude Code skills and plugins for day-to-day dev work: side panes, session stats, time tracking and manual test plans.

plugins.name: desk
plugins.description: A work pane for the branch you're on: its GitHub issue and acceptance criteria, its PR's checks and reviews, your local dev services, and a where-you-left-off note.

plugins.name: session-stats
plugins.description: A live pane of session stats (tokens, prompt cache, usage limits, cost, tools, agents) with alerts, a done notification, and cache-tax's keepwarm and cold-send guard.

plugins.name: log-time
plugins.description: Log a day's work to Harvest from the tickets in your git commits and GitHub PRs.

plugins.name: manual-test-plan
plugins.description: Build a manual test plan for the ticket you're on, as a web page to tick through: cases written from the spec, not the code, with real records from your local database.
